name_input: M/S FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITESD; M/S FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; FANUC INDIA RIVATE LIMITED; FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LTD.; FANUC INDIA PVT. LTD.; FANUC INDIA PRIVATE LINITED; FANUC INDIA PVT LTD
note: Registry data NOT verified in this run: web_search backend was down (searx connection refused) and all registry aggregators (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck, instafinancials) returned 403/empty; Bing/Google/DDG returned no usable snippets. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and revenue are all null — not public/not retrieved, not invented. Only confirmed fact: the company exists and operates as FANUC India, a 100% wholly owned subsidiary of FANUC Corporation (Japan), 'Established in 1992', 23 locations, per its own website https://www.fanucindia.com/ (self-declared, not a registry record). Role assessed as manufacturer_trader on the basis of the company's own description of supplying CNC systems, ROBOTs, ROBOMACHINE (ROBODRILL/ROBOSHOT/ROBOCUT) and IoT products plus service/repair — i.e. imported/assembled capital equipment sold and serviced in India; this is a business-model inference, not a registry classification. No rejection grounds found (entity clearly active and trading), but MCA status is unverified. Declared HS 842430 (sand/steam blasting machines) and 853810 (parts for electrical control panels) do not match the actual product line (CNC controllers, industrial robots, machine tools, injection moulding and EDM machines — more consistent with HS 8457/8458/8459/8462/8479/8537); per project rule this is NOT a rejection ground — company retained, HS to be corrected to actual. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is not supported: FANUC India serves automotive, electronics, pharma, FMCG, metal fabrication and machine-tool building as an automation supplier, not a metals/mining producer. Recommended follow-up: re-run registry lookup for CIN/PAN/GSTIN and pull MCA financials for FY25/FY26.
